entries.reason: The divisor-membership condition relative to B and the parity condition are resolved through exhaustive, mutually exclusive cases; a case-partition visual should expose the case conditions, surviving values, and elimination reasons.
The question asks for the union and intersection of two movie-attendance sets while giving the outside count; a two-set cardinality Venn makes the outside, union, overlap, and region counts explicit.
X∩A=A forces every element of A into X, while X-B=X forbids every element of B; the remaining universe elements are free, so forced/forbidden/free buckets directly represent the subset count.

The maximum and minimum possible overlap of two sets inside a 24-student universe are extreme cardinality configurations; a cardinality Venn should show the maximal containment and minimal-overlap states.

Equality of the two unions forces the elements in both set-difference blocks into X, while the common and outside elements remain free; forced/free buckets make the resulting subset count transparent.
